tables.name: account_deletion_audit
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_deletion_audit_pkey ON public.account_deletion_audit USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX account_deletion_audit_request_idx ON public.account_deletion_audit USING btree (request_id, event_at)

constraints.name: account_deletion_audit_request_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES account_deletion_requests(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: account_deletion_requests
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_deletion_requests_pkey ON public.account_deletion_requests USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_deletion_requests_profile_id_client_request_id_key ON public.account_deletion_requests USING btree (profile_id, client_request_id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_deletion_requests_one_active_per_profile ON public.account_deletion_requests USING btree (profile_id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'reviewing'::text, 'processing'::text, 'failed'::text]))

constraints.name: account_deletion_requests_organization_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: account_deletion_requests_profile_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: mobile_device_registrations
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mobile_device_registrations_pkey ON public.mobile_device_registrations USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mobile_device_registrations_profile_id_expo_push_token_app__key ON public.mobile_device_registrations USING btree (profile_id, expo_push_token, app_profile)

constraints.name: mobile_device_registrations_profile_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

policies.with_check:
((bucket_id = ANY (ARRAY['project-photos'::text, 'thermal-photos'::text])) AND
CASE
    WHEN (name ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/daily_log/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/[0-9a-f-]+-.+$'::text) THEN ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
       FROM daily_logs dl
      WHERE ((dl.id = (split_part(objects.name, '/'::text, 3))::uuid) AND (dl.project_id = (split_part(objects.name, '/'::text, 1))::uuid) AND (dl.created_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))) AND ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
       FROM profiles p
      WHERE ((p.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (p.role = 'admin'::text)))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
       FROM project_members pm
      WHERE ((pm.project_id = (split_part(objects.name, '/'::text, 1))::uuid) AND (pm.profile_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND pm.can_edit AND (pm.project_role = ANY (ARRAY['manager'::text, 'superintendent'::text, 'foreman'::text, 'contractor'::text])))))))
    ELSE false
END)

   FROM profiles profile
  WHERE ((profile.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (profile.role = 'admin'::text)))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

policies.policyname: Mobile invitees can add invited membership
policies.with_check:
((profile_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM project_invitations invitation
  WHERE ((invitation.project_id = project_members.project_id) AND (invitation.project_role = project_members.project_role) AND (invitation.status = 'pending'::text) AND (invitation.expires_at > now()) AND (lower(invitation.email) = lower(( SELECT profile.email
           FROM profiles profile
          WHERE (profile.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))) AND (project_members.can_edit = (invitation.project_role = ANY (ARRAY['manager'::text, 'superintendent'::text, 'foreman'::text, 'engineer'::text])))))))
